title: Run for your life! At a comfortable pace, and not too far: James O'Keefe at TEDxUMKC
summary: Cardiologist James O'Keefe argues in a TEDx talk that moderate running confers the best longevity benefits, while extreme endurance training can damage the heart. He draws on data and his own experience as a lifelong runner.
why: HN cites it whenever people question whether more exercise is always better, especially extreme endurance running.

quote.text: I think about this TED Talk from 2012 a lot..
